context.purpose: Prepare a typed nullable CSV table for Parquet interchange, with an optional declared-schema typed CSV publication, keeping exact identifiers, Unicode and UTC microseconds.
context.assumptions: Explicit six-type schema, nullability and reserved \N; isolated PyArrow26.0.0/C++26.0.0 on POSIX.
context.constraints: 32 columns,10000 rows,200000 cells,8MiB CSV (also the table.csv limit),4096-byte text cells; no metadata/units,nested types,SQL or general Parquet input; table.csv has no type metadata.
context.inspection: Inspect table-report.json; independent decoding checks every output value/null/type, native CSV snapshots check all source cells, and an opted-in table.csv is checked byte-for-byte against its canonical encoding and parsed under the declared schema.
context.recovery: Correct located source/column/predicate/selection/literal/publishCSV faults, shorten or disable an over-budget CSV publication, configure isolated native Python, retain failed verification evidence and retry in a fresh directory.

workflow.scope: Verified CSV artifact paths (including an opted-in table.csv at artifact index 2, which the consumer must declare with the identical schema) and report values use scheduled workflow handoffs.

composition.scope: Shared references, expressions and finite studies resolve to the same literal table contract.

lifecycle.timeout: Single total deadline plus native CPU30s,AS2GiB,FSIZE32MiB caps; default60s.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process-group cancellation and prepublication check.
lifecycle.logs: Captured CSV,authored/plan/config/worker/current implementation fingerprints,consumed-input hashes,submissions/stdout/stderr, including the csvreadback stage when table.csv is published.
lifecycle.verification: Independent stdlib CSV oracle and closed Parquet Compact-Thrift/PLAIN/null-level decoder; exact float bits,logical schema,all nulls and ordered rows. Additional native source and fresh reopen snapshots. An opted-in table.csv must equal the host canonical encoding byte-for-byte, parse under the declared schema to the same typed rows and match a native declared-schema reopen.
